c74object.name: el.clean_gate~
c74object.digest: Click-free signal router and gate with smooth crossfading
c74object.description:
el.clean_gate~ routes a single audio input to one of multiple outputs with smooth, click-free crossfades. Similar to gate~, setting the channel to 0 closes the gate (all outputs muted), while values from 1 to N route the audio signal to the corresponding output channel. Routing transitions can use equal-power or linear crossfading. When an audio-rate signal is connected to the left inlet, switching is sample-accurate.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / int / float): Gate select. Specifies destination outlet (0 = closed/muted, 1 to N = active output). When connected to a signal, switching is sample-accurate.
Inlet 2 (signal): Audio input signal to be routed.
Outlets
Outlets 1 to N (signal): Audio signal outputs (2 to 8192 channels, determined by the first argument, default: 2). The routed input crossfades cleanly between these outlets without clicks.

inlet.description: Selects the active output channel. 0 mutes all outputs; 1 to N routes the audio input to that specific outlet number. Accepts an audio signal for sample-accurate routing, or control-rate numbers (int, float).
The incoming audio signal to be gated and routed.

outlet.description: Subsequent audio signal output channels (up to 8192 outlets).

objarg.name: outlet-count
objarg.description: The number of output channels to create (default: 2, range: 2 to 8192).

objarg.name: crossfade-duration
objarg.description: Crossfade duration in milliseconds applied when switching between gates (default: 50.0 ms).

method.name: channel
method.description: Sets the active output channel (0 closes the gate, 1 to N opens that output). Triggers a smooth crossfade from the previous channel.

method.name: fadetime
method.description: Sets the crossfade duration in milliseconds (clamped to 0.1 – 100,000 ms).

method.name: float
method.description: Float input into the left inlet selects the active output channel (truncated to integer).

method.name: int
method.description: Integer input into the left inlet selects the active output channel (0 closes the gate, 1 to N opens that output).

method.name: linear
method.description: When set to 1, crossfading between channels uses a linear amplitude ramp. When set to 0 (default), equal-power (sine/cosine) crossfading is used.

method.name: signal
method.digest: Audio-rate gate select or input signal
method.description: Signal arriving at inlet 1 provides sample-accurate channel selection. Signal arriving at inlet 2 is the audio signal to be routed.
